name: Calendar
description: Your notes on a calendar, by a date in their properties: a month, an endless scroll of weeks, or the whole year. Notes that span several days show as one bar. Tap a note to open it; double-click (or long-press on a phone) an empty day to create a note on it. Turn a whole page into a calendar from the ⋯ menu, or type ```calendar in a note. Based on Just Simple Calendar by David Hurtado (MIT).
tagline: Your notes by date: month, weeks or year
author: Granite, from Just Simple Calendar by David Hurtado
